_comment: Octail's own egg (plan §6.4), built on games-steamcmd vein/egg-v-e-i-n.json (pelican-eggs, MIT licence) and checked against the app's Steam data (app 2131400: a Linux depot, VeinServer.sh starting Vein/Binaries/Linux/VeinServer-Linux-Test). Octail runs the Linux binary itself with the game and query ports, sets the name, password, player limit, server list switch, bind address and query port in Vein/Saved/Config/LinuxServer/Game.ini with the ini parser (sections as the game's sample Game.ini has them; the parser adds a missing file, section or key) instead of upstream's line edits of a file downloaded from a paste site, makes the password optional (upstream required one), gives the query port its own automatic port (port_vars) with the Steam query (A2S) for player counts, port readiness (UDP, x_octail.features.ready) besides the start line, install sandbox defaults and resource hints, the anonymous login only, and the install fails when SteamCMD didn't download the server. SteamCMD is retried up to 3 times: its first run on a fresh install often fails with "Missing configuration". SteamCMD exits 0 even when an install failed (Missing configuration), so its retry loop counts a run as done only on SteamCMD's "Success! App" line.
name: VEIN
author: eggs@octail.net
description: Survive the end of the world in a large, detailed open world: scavenge, build a base, farm and fight off zombies alone or with friends. The Linux dedicated server.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
## Octail curated install: SteamCMD downloads the Linux build of the server.
## Server Files: /mnt/server

## anonymous login: this server needs no Steam account
STEAM_USER=anonymous
STEAM_PASS=""
STEAM_AUTH=""

## download and install steamcmd (the small archive goes to /tmp, the game straight to the server's disk)
cd /tmp || exit 1
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamcmd
curl -fsSL --connect-timeout 30 --max-time 300 --retry 3 --retry-delay 5 -o steamcmd.tar.gz https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/client/installer/steamcmd_linux.tar.gz || { echo "Downloading SteamCMD failed."; exit 1; }
tar -xzvf steamcmd.tar.gz -C /mnt/server/steamcmd
rm -f steamcmd.tar.gz
mkdir -p /mnt/server/steamapps # Fix steamcmd disk write error when this folder is missing
cd /mnt/server/steamcmd || exit 1

# SteamCMD fails otherwise for some reason, even running as root.
# This is changed at the end of the install process anyways.
chown -R root:root /mnt
export HOME=/mnt/server

## install game using steamcmd
## Octail: SteamCMD's first run often fails with "Missing configuration"; try up to 3 times
for steamcmd_try in 1 2 3; do
    if ./steamcmd.sh +force_install_dir /mnt/server +login ${STEAM_USER} ${STEAM_PASS} ${STEAM_AUTH} +app_update ${SRCDS_APPID} $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAID} ]] || printf %s "-beta ${SRCDS_BETAID}" ) $( [[ -z ${SRCDS_BETAPASS} ]] || printf %s "-betapassword ${SRCDS_BETAPASS}" ) validate +quit 2>&1 | tee /tmp/steamcmd.log && grep -q "Success! App '" /tmp/steamcmd.log && ! grep -q "ERROR! Failed to install app" /tmp/steamcmd.log; then break; fi
    echo "SteamCMD did not finish (attempt $steamcmd_try of 3)"
done

## set up 32 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk32
cp -v linux32/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk32/steamclient.so

## set up 64 bit libraries
mkdir -p /mnt/server/.steam/sdk64
cp -v linux64/steamclient.so ../.steam/sdk64/steamclient.so

## Octail: fail the install when SteamCMD didn't download the server
if [[ ! -f "/mnt/server/Vein/Binaries/Linux/VeinServer-Linux-Test" ]]; then
    echo -e "\nSteamCMD failed to install the VEIN dedicated server; try reinstalling."
    exit 1
fi
chmod +x "/mnt/server/Vein/Binaries/Linux/VeinServer-Linux-Test"

## Game.ini is written by the panel before every start (ini parser); the folder is made here.
mkdir -p /mnt/server/Vein/Saved/Config/LinuxServer

## install end
echo "-----------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed..."
echo "-----------------------------------------"

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: The name in the server browser (no double quotes or backslashes).

variables.name: Server Password
variables.description: Optional: players must enter it to join (case-sensitive). Empty = no password; otherwise 4 to 32 letters, digits, - and _.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: How many players can be online at once.

variables.name: Public Server
variables.description: True lists the server in the in-game server browser; False hides it (players join by address).

variables.name: Query Port
variables.description: Steam query port (UDP), for the server list. Set by Octail when the server is created (the port after the game port).

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update the server with SteamCMD before every start (1 = on, 0 = off).
